title: Time Cooperative
creator: Adolf Hohenstein

art_history.visual_reason: 伸展身体、盘绕曲线与圆胖装饰字形在平面中互相缠绕。

transferable_concepts.reason: 钟面将抽象时间变成主要视觉物

analysis.visual_mechanism: 时钟占上角，伸出的手臂穿过画面，圆胖标题稳住底部。此处描述以所见图像为依据。
analysis.transferable_method: 可迁移的编排策略：时钟占上角，伸出的手臂穿过画面，圆胖标题稳住底部；改用于书籍宣传时，以书的核心物象替换主图，沿原有文字区安排书名和一条核心信息。
analysis.failure_modes: 这一结构依赖钟面将抽象时间变成主要视觉物；若把书名、作者和多条卖点都放到主图轮廓内部，会削弱该关系。
analysis.annotation_rationale: Collected and initially annotated separately; root inspected the complete local image, compared the primary-source identity and corrected visible classification conflicts.

review.reviewer: Codex root independent acceptance after collector and annotator passes
review.source_check: Matched title, creator (including explicit unknown), date and record identity to preserved primary record aic-17079; image visually corresponds to the work.
review.visual_check: Selected contact sheet 0. Full image identity, main composition, visual family, text density and source correspondence inspected; minor imprint text not transcribed.
